GlassSearchLauncher

Поле, которое не редактируется на месте, а открывает слой поиска над всей страницей.

Как выглядит

Что это

Выглядит как GlassSearchBar; по нажатию поле уезжает наверх, страница гаснет, под полем показываются результаты resultsBuilder. bottomBuilder — что докнуть над клавиатурой (фильтр сегментами).

GlassSearchLauncher(
  hintText: 'Search chats',
  resultsBuilder: (context, query) => ListView(children: [
    for (final c in chats.where((c) => c.contains(query))) ListRow(title: c),
  ]),
  onClosed: () => setState(() => filter = ''),
)

Параметры (из dartdoc)

GlassSearchLauncher
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
resultsBuilderGlassSearchResultsBuilderrequiredWhat the layer shows under the field.
bottomBuilderWidgetBuilder?Something docked at the bottom of the layer, above the keyboard (a filter segmented control, say). It slides in with the layer.
controllerTextEditingController?The query. Owned by the launcher when null.
hintTextString'Search'
cancelLabelString'Cancel'
onChangedValueChanged<String>?
onSubmittedValueChanged<String>?
onOpenedVoidCallback?The layer started opening.
onClosedVoidCallback?The layer is closed (the query has been cleared). Tell the page to drop the filter here.
heightdouble44
liquidbooltruetrue (default): the field is a glass plate, as GlassSearchBar.liquid. false: a flat field, no backdrop pass.
fillColor?
cancelAsButtonbooltruetrue (default): a round cross button, the messenger look. false: the text cancelLabel.
backgroundColorColor?The layer's page colour; the theme background when null.
layerPaddingEdgeInsetsconst EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16)The inset of the field from the sides of the screen once the layer is open (the launcher itself sits where you put it).
useRootNavigatorbooltruetrue (default): the layer covers the whole app (the bars of an enclosing shell too), not only the nested navigator the page is in.
